context_files_read.purpose: Confirm phase-loop and P14 boundary before designing L08.
key_findings: P14 is opt-in only and requires VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
Scale phases must use real 10/30/50/100 gates; 1000-node behavior is dry-run/resource-check only.

context_files_read.purpose: Use current-stage read context and constraints.
key_findings: L08 must produce fault, failover, workload-window, real evidence, and cleanup artifacts for 30, 50, and 100 nodes.
Resource insufficiency for real 30/50/100 gates is a blocker, not a pass condition.
L08 must add deterministic fake tests, 30/50/100 real fault/failover gates, safety guards, failover schema, and before/during/after workload windows.
Each real rung must emit fault_report_N, failover_report_N, workload_window_report_N, valkey_e2e_evidence_fault_N, and cleanup_report_fault_N.
Current wrapper supports min-nodes and primary-stop promotion proof.
It writes valkey_e2e_evidence and failover_report but not named fault_report_N, workload_window_report_N, or cleanup_report_fault_N outputs.
Supported node_stop stops an owned container by container_name.
clear_fault currently clears fault state but does not prove post-clear node restoration for node_stop.
Current coverage matrix marks 30/50/100 fault, failover, and workload surfaces as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
L08 must add metrics sourced from machine-readable artifacts, not rendered reports.

findings.description: Committed coverage currently has no 30/50/100 fault or failover real evidence.
evidence: coverage_matrix.json marks fault and failover for layers 30, 50, and 100 as SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
metric_catalog.json has zero fault/failover metrics for evidence layers 30, 50, and 100.

findings.description: scripts/fault_failover_gate.py is insufficient for L08 artifact contract as written.
evidence: The wrapper accepts --out and --failover-report, but not --fault-report, --workload-window-report, or --cleanup-report.
The wrapper writes cleanup_report.json, not cleanup_report_fault_<N>.json.

findings.description: Existing schemas are intentionally permissive and cannot alone enforce L08 metrics.
evidence: fault_report.schema.json and failover_report.schema.json allow additionalProperties and generic object arrays.
workload_report.schema.json has aggregate workload fields but no before/during/after windows.

findings.description: Fault clear semantics for node_stop need explicit validation before large-rung PASS can be trusted.
evidence: clear_fault clears state but does not prove the stopped node rejoined or encode a measured restore path.
L08 requires fault clear latency and cluster/node observations before/during/after.

findings.description: P14 real fault/failover execution must be blocked by harness, not just by convention.
evidence: CODEX_START_HERE.md states P14 may only run with explicit opt-in and environment token.
Coverage builder already has a 1000-dry-run layer, so L08 must prevent accidental real_valkey_coverage=true for 1000 fault/failover artifacts.

proposed_harness.name: workload_window_report.schema.json
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add a strict schema for artifact_type=workload_window_report requiring node_count in [30,50,100], windows named before_fault, during_fault, after_fault, availability, errors, timeouts, latency percentiles, source evidence paths, and explicit missing semantics.

proposed_harness.name: fault_failover_scale.schema.json
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add a scale-level audit schema for artifacts/loop_engineering/reports/fault_failover_scale.json with canonical_rungs [30,50,100], source_artifacts with sha256, safety checks, before/during/after cluster observations, workload references, cleanup residual counts, and p14_boundary real_valkey_coverage=false.

proposed_harness.name: deterministic fake artifact tests
proposed_harness.acceptance: Create tests that build synthetic 30/50/100 fault/failover artifact bundles and verify the audit accepts complete measured artifacts and rejects missing windows, unsafe scopes, bad node counts, and invented split-brain values.

proposed_harness.name: fault_failover_gate artifact contract
proposed_harness.acceptance: Extend scripts/fault_failover_gate.py to accept --fault-report, --workload-window-report, --cleanup-report, --scenario, and --min-nodes; write the canonical per-rung artifact names; and fail nonzero if any required output is absent or invalid.

proposed_harness.name: 30_50_100 real fault/failover gates
proposed_harness.acceptance: Run resource preflight and then wrapper-produced real primary-stop failover evidence for 30, 50, and 100 nodes.

proposed_harness.name: fault_failover_scale artifact audit
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add scripts/audit_fault_failover_scale.py that reads only JSON/JSONL source artifacts, validates all 30/50/100 outputs, checks cross-artifact consistency, emits fault_failover_scale.json, and exits nonzero on blocking findings.

proposed_harness.name: metric coverage integration
proposed_harness.acceptance: Extend build_metric_coverage_matrix.py to add measured 30/50/100 metrics for fault, failover, and workload from fault_failover_scale.json while keeping 1000-dry-run real_valkey_coverage=false.

proposed_harness.name: CI coverage gate
proposed_harness.acceptance: Add CI tests that run schema validation, audit_fault_failover_scale.py, metric coverage checks, P14 boundary assertions, and safety_scan.py without requiring live Valkey in ordinary CI.

implementation_plan.step: Define L08 source artifact contracts without weakening existing P07/P08 schemas.
implementation_plan.rationale: Existing schemas are permissive for backward compatibility; L08 needs strict scale-specific audit artifacts.
Fake tmp_path artifacts should prove the validator catches missing windows, unsafe scopes, bad node counts, invented values, and missing reasons before real Valkey runs.

implementation_plan.step: Extend the failover wrapper to produce the L08 artifact bundle.
implementation_plan.rationale: The real wrapper must create named outputs, measure latencies, observe before/during/after cluster state, and stay inside owned Docker/container boundaries.

implementation_plan.step: Integrate L08 metrics into coverage and reports.
implementation_plan.rationale: Coverage matrix and views must show 30/50/100 fault/failover/workload coverage while preserving P14 boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: For each N in 30, 50, and 100, the canonical artifact bundle exists.

Each real evidence artifact is produced by scripts/fault_failover_gate.py, has real_valkey=true, status=PASS, probe_result=PASS, Valkey versions matching 9.1.x, and nodes_observed consistent with expected semantics.
Each rung records numeric fault_apply_latency_ms, fault_clear_latency_ms, promotion_observed=true, failover_latency_ms, workload errors/timeouts before/during/after, and cleanup residual count.
Cluster observations include cluster_state and nodes_observed before_fault, during_fault, after_promotion, and after_clear.
Split-brain indicators are measured when available; otherwise they are encoded as MISSING with value=null and a nonempty reason.
P14 remains dry-run/planner/resource only; no 1000-node fault/failover real evidence exists.
risks: 100-node primary-stop plus workload windows may exceed local Docker CPU or memory.
Node-stop clear may require restoring an owned stopped container; if restoration is not implemented, after_clear semantics must fail or block.
Workload windows can be misleading if summarized after the fact.
Strengthening existing schemas directly could break historical P07/P08 artifacts; prefer L08-specific strict audit schemas plus backward-compatible base schemas.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not handwrite PASS into gate results or evidence artifacts.
Do not count fake deterministic tests as real Valkey proof.
Do not reuse P07/P08 small-real artifacts as 30/50/100 coverage.
Do not run P14 or any 1000-node real fault/failover gate in this stage.
Do not use sudo, host routing, host firewall, PF, nftables, iptables, ifconfig, networksetup, or host network mode.
Do not mark resource insufficiency as PASS or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON.
Do not use rendered HTML, Markdown, CSV, or SVG reports as metric sources.
notes: No files were edited. The harness should be implemented before real L08 gate runs; current repository state lacks the required 30/50/100 fault/failover artifact bundle and should fail the proposed checks until implementation and real wrapper evidence are added.
